lines: I should get back to checking the beds before the weeds get comfortable.
Best I return to the rows before the sun slips too low.
The crops will not tend themselves.
There is feed to split and a fence that has been leaning at me all morning.
I promised a helper I would look over the south patch.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to watering, tilling, and straightening what has gone crooked.
I need to see if the goats stayed out of the beans this time.
The soil is waiting, and it does not like to be kept waiting.
I have seed to sort and tools to put away before dusk.
I'll be back in the fields once we are done here.
